records.question: Are the items returned most often also the ones that were on promotion?

attempts.sql:
WITH returned_items AS (
  SELECT item.i_item_sk, item.i_item_id, item.i_product_name, COUNT(*) AS return_count
  FROM store_returns AS sr
  JOIN item AS item ON sr.sr_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY item.i_item_sk, item.i_item_id, item.i_product_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT item.i_item_sk, item.i_item_id, item.i_product_name, COUNT(*) AS return_count
  FROM catalog_returns AS cr
  JOIN item AS item ON cr.cr_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY item.i_item_sk, item.i_item_id, item.i_product_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT item.i_item_sk, item.i_item_id, item.i_product_name, COUNT(*) AS return_count
  FROM web_returns AS wr
  JOIN item AS item ON wr.wr_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY item.i_item_sk, item.i_item_id, item.i_product_name
), return_totals AS (
  SELECT returned_items.i_item_sk, returned_items.i_item_id, returned_items.i_product_name, SUM(returned_items.return_count) AS return_count
  FROM returned_items
  GROUP BY returned_items.i_item_sk, returned_items.i_item_id, returned_items.i_product_name
), promoted_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT promotion.p_item_sk AS i_item_sk
  FROM promotion
), ranked AS (
  SELECT return_totals.i_item_sk, return_totals.i_item_id, return_totals.i_product_name, return_totals.return_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_totals.return_count DESC) AS return_rank,
         promoted_items.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AS was_on_promotion
  FROM return_totals
  LEFT JOIN promoted_items ON return_totals.i_item_sk = promoted_items.i_item_sk
)
SELECT ranked.i_item_id, ranked.i_product_name, ranked.return_count, ranked.was_on_promotion
FROM ranked
WHERE ranked.return_rank = 1
